## [1.0.0-dev.41](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.0-dev.40...v1.0.0-dev.41) (2026-11-05)

### ✨ New Features

* Set the level of spawned creatures that scale, tap the hunger summary to edit hunger, Title Case buttons, and confirm attacks from 2 tiles by default ([90d84c4](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/90d84c459fb005cc159e950d0aebe865154513fe))

patches.name: Character editor
patches.description: Adds a Character button to the in-game menu for editing health, level, experience, strength, talents and status effects, and for adding modifiers to accuracy, evasion, damage, armor, speed and regeneration. Changes are saved with the run.

patches.name: Enemy editor
patches.description: Adds an Edit button when you examine an enemy, NPC or other creature, for editing its health, side, behavior and status effects.

patches.name: Floor editor
patches.description: Adds a Floor button to the in-game menu and an Edit tile button when you examine a tile or trap, for removing or adding gases and other area effects and for adding, removing, hiding, revealing and disarming traps.

patches.name: Hunger editor
patches.description: Adds a Hunger window for changing how long each hunger stage lasts, how often and how hard starvation hurts, or disabling hunger. Main menu settings are the default for every game; changes made during a game are saved to that game.

patches.name: Inventory editor
patches.description: Adds an Inventory button to the in-game menu for editing gold and energy, adding any item in the game, and opening the backpack with an Edit button on every item (level, quantity, curses, enchantments, glyphs, augments and charges).

patches.name: Public save folder
patches.description: Stores save files in a public folder on the device so they can be opened with any file manager. Asks for storage access on first launch and copies existing saves over.

options.description: Folder relative to the root of the device storage.

patches.name: QoL enhancements
patches.description: Quality of life options in the Extras menu. Confirm actions: a tap that would attack, walk somewhere, use stairs or step into danger first shows what will happen, with Go and Cancel buttons. Fearless shopkeeper: the shopkeeper never runs off with the shop. List everything on a tile: examining a tile lists every item in a pile and the tile itself. Unlimited inventory space.

patches.name: Save backup
patches.description: Adds Export saves and Import saves to the Extras menu and to the app icon shortcuts (long-press it) for backing up and restoring all saves as a zip file.

patches.name: Save file access
patches.description: Exposes the game's save folder in the system file picker and Files app so saves can be copied, backed up, and edited.

patches.name: Supporter options
patches.description:
NOTICE: This patch is not intended to gain these bonus extras for free. It is meant to ensure supporters are able to keep the benefits they paid for. Don't be a scumbag. Please support the developer!

Adds Supporter options to the Extras menu: keep your Silver, Golden or Shattered supporter rewards, and hide the Support button on the title screen. Only works on the Google Play version of the game.

patches.name: Uncompressed saves
patches.description: Writes save files as plain JSON instead of GZIP so they can be edited in any text editor. Existing compressed saves still load and are converted the next time the game saves.

patches.name: Unlock all
patches.description: Adds toggles to the Extras menu that unlock all heroes, guide books, intros and lore, the item catalog and the bestiary. Your save data is not changed, so turning a toggle off restores your real progress.
